scope: Libya medical discovery — University of Tripoli Faculty of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: University of Tripoli's programme directory lists a Bachelor in Medicine and General Surgery with a 10-semester, 166-unit study plan.

The programme directory describes basic-science, clinical and internship stages; clinical training takes place in Tripoli teaching hospitals and the internship assigns students to educational hospitals under doctors' supervision.
The Faculty's published MBChB syllabus describes seven academic and clinical training years, including a final one-year internship served as internal doctors in a teaching hospital.

The published MBChB syllabus states that limited annual admission requires excellent grades of at least 85% in the Medical Sciences branch of the Libyan secondary certificate and a competition examination; the current programme directory also lists a secondary certificate, acceptance test and interview among entry requirements.

holdReasons: The programme directory and syllabus present differing duration structures, requiring current faculty clarification before a publication-ready profile can be prepared.
Current official fee, recognition, instructional-language and student-support evidence remains incomplete.
nextAction: Obtain a current Faculty of Medicine admission notice and fee/recognition/language/support publications, reconcile the programme duration, then complete the field-level review before publishing.
